patterns.note: Full-width, distinct vertical sections, often featuring a single hero product or a grid of related products, with primary headings and subheadings consistently centered.

A consistent, clean sans-serif typeface used across all text elements, with a clear hierarchy established through size and weight, from large, bold headlines to small, light body text and legal disclaimers.
Predominantly a clean, bright white background with black or dark grey text, punctuated by vibrant product photography and a distinctive 'Apple Blue' for interactive elements like buttons and links.

A sticky top navigation bar remains visible throughout scrolling. Main content sections reveal sequentially by sliding up from the bottom of the viewport as the user scrolls down, creating a clear progression through the page content.
Prominent, full-bleed product showcase sections that dominate the viewport, often featuring high-quality photography or renders of devices, followed by concise descriptive text and calls to action.

technique_notes: The site uses a sticky header navigation that remains at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, ensuring constant access to main navigation links.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width vertical sections that smoothly slide into view from the bottom as the user scrolls down the page, creating a clear, linear narrative flow.
Product displays leverage high-resolution, full-bleed photography or 3D renders, often against a clean white or light grey background, to emphasize the product's design and features.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, and clean sans-serif headings (up to ~3-4x body size) with generous line height, paired with smaller, lighter-weight body text and very fine print for legal disclaimers.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners applied consistently to buttons, product images, and UI elements, creating a soft, approachable feel without being overly 'rounded'.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, with significant vertical padding between major content sections to give each product or promotion ample breathing room, while internal content within sections maintains a comfortable density.

standout: The site's design stands out through its unparalleled use of high-resolution, full-bleed product photography and renders, which serve as the primary visual anchors for each section. This, combined with a minimalist layout and a precise, consistent typographic hierarchy, creates an immediate sense of premium quality and brand authority that is difficult to replicate without similar visual assets.
